name: Default Scanrix Safety Ruleset
description: Deterministic safety rules mapping regulatory and scientific facts to risk dimensions
disclaimer: This analysis is for informational purposes only and does not constitute medical, legal, or health advice.

rules.label: Carcinogenic to humans (WHO IARC Group 1)
rules.description: Ingredient has sufficient scientific evidence of carcinogenicity in humans according to the World Health Organization.

rules.label: Probably carcinogenic to humans (WHO IARC Group 2A)
rules.description: Ingredient has strong mechanistic evidence and limited human evidence of carcinogenicity.

rules.label: Possibly carcinogenic to humans (WHO IARC Group 2B)
rules.description: Ingredient has limited evidence of carcinogenicity in humans and less than sufficient evidence in experimental animals.

rules.label: California Proposition 65 Carcinogen
rules.description: Listed by California OEHHA as known to the state to cause cancer.

rules.label: California Proposition 65 Developmental Toxin
rules.description: Listed by California OEHHA as causing harm to fetal development and pregnancy.

rules.label: California Proposition 65 Reproductive Toxin
rules.description: Listed by California OEHHA as causing reproductive harm in males or females.

rules.label: Prohibited / Banned Substance
rules.description: Prohibited for use in consumer products by regulatory authorities.

rules.label: Known Major Allergen
rules.description: Classified as a common food or cosmetic contact allergen.

rules.label: Contains a common allergen
rules.description: Ingredient is, or is derived from, one of the common food allergens. Informational: it is only a concern for people with that allergy.

rules.label: Listed as prohibited in EU cosmetics (Annex II)
rules.description: Listed in Annex II of the EU Cosmetics Regulation (substances prohibited in cosmetic products). Informational: CosIng has no legal value.

rules.label: Restricted in EU cosmetics (Annex III)
rules.description: Listed in Annex III of the EU Cosmetics Regulation: allowed only within the stated restrictions.
